question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
To find the percentage by which the cost per kg of gain in T1 was lower than in the control group, we need to calculate the difference between the cost per kg of gain in the control group and T1, then divide by the cost per kg of gain in the control group, and finally multiply by 100.

Cost per kg of gain in T1: 169.94
Cost per kg of gain in the control group: 210

Difference: 210 - 169.94 = 40.06
Percentage: (40.06 / 210) * 100 ≈ 19.07%

The cost per kg of gain in T1 was approximately 19.07% lower than in the control group.
